about.builderBody: I lead Internet Banking delivery at Airtel Payments Bank (SDE III) for a platform serving ~1 million users per day. My focus is product UI quality, team execution, and shipping reliable customer journeys under RBI compliance. Previously at DotPe, I led 4 engineers on billing & F&B products (50k+ DAU, ₹1 Cr+ daily revenue).
